notes.kin.velocity: A velocity vector requires scalar speed and trajectory-derived direction. Reuse ego_speed and ego_trajectory where required; nearby traffic speeds belong to those participants. Do not treat this mixed observation atom as an additional independent ego speed.
notes.derived_comparisons: Keep the unresolved phrase in the law template and record its underlying physical observables for fixed sampling and later external labeling. They are not new observed subject-speed variables.
